"''Such as, what do we do now that it's ''over''?|Kes Dameron and Shara Bey|}} '''Kes Dameron''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel trooper|soldier]] who served as a [[sergeant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was [[Marriage|married]] to [[Shara Bey]], a [[Rebel pilot]], with whom he had a son named [[Poe Dameron|Poe]]. They both fought against the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Battle of Endor]], during which Dameron was part of the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]], a special forces strike team led by [[General]] [[Han Solo]] that destroyed the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II's]] [[deflector shield generator]]. After the Empire's defeat during the battle, both Dameron and Bey participated in an [[Assault on an Imperial outpost|assault]] on an [[Imperial outpost (Endor)|outpost]] manned by Imperial holdouts on [[Endor]]. Dameron fought with the Pathfinders for the next several [[Standard week|weeks]], including the [[raid at the Wretch of Tayron]]. After fighting their way into an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] black site, the team was able to gain data needed to uncover and stop [[Operation: Cinder]], an Imperial operation designed to destroy numerous worlds to avenge the [[death]] of the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], [[Darth Sidious]], who had been killed during the Battle of Endor. Three [[Standard month|months]] after the raid, Dameron and Bey both left Rebel service and began a new life together. At their [[Dameron homestead|new home]] on [[Yavin 4]], they planted a fragment of a [[Great Tree (Coruscant)|Force-sensitive tree]], one that had once dwelled at the heart of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], after it had been gifted to Bey by [[Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. ==Biography== Kes Dameron attended a [[university]], where he took two [[architect]]ure courses, though he barely passed one.{{StoryCite|story=An Echo of Victory|book=Empire Ascendant 1}} ===Galactic Civil War=== {{Quote|People were hurting. People were suffering. Your father and I couldn't sit and do nothing.|Shara Bey, to her son Poe|''[[Before the Awakening]]''}} Kes Dameron was a [[Rebel trooper|soldier]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during its fight against the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was [[Marriage|married]] to [[Rebel pilot]] [[Shara Bey]], with whom he served in the Rebel Alliance, and together they had a son, [[Poe Dameron|Poe]].[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]] Because of their service in the Rebellion, Dameron and Bey only saw each other for short periods of time, often for [[Standard hour|hour]]-long intervals after several [[Standard week|weeks]] apart.[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]] Despite their separation, they eventually started their family with the birth of their son, [[Poe Dameron|Poe]],[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]] in [[2 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that [[Poe Dameron]] was [[Reproduction|born]] thirty-two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, Dameron must have been born in [[2 ABY]]. Poe lived with [[Shara Bey's father|Bey's father]] as his parents continued their service, with both Dameron and Bey unable to frequently visit him. [[File:DameronsEchoBase-AnEchoOfVictory.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dameron and Bey working on Echo Base's tunnels]] At [[Hoth]], Dameron helped design [[Echo Base]]. With Bey he used an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] [[RG-9 laser cannon|cannon]] to carve out tunnels for the base. As they worked, one of the tunnels collapsed and the pair were trapped. Dameron offered Bey his equipment so she could survive long enough to be rescued. She refused to let him [[Death|die]], but both were rescued by [[Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Chewbacca]]. Dameron and Bey were then taken aboard a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] for medical treatment. Following the [[Battle of Hoth]], Dameron was aboard a [[CR90 corvette]] with rest of the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]]. He watched as his wife's [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] fought off [[TIE series|TIEs]] during a [[Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three|battle]] at [[Rendezvous Point Delta-Three]].[[Star Wars (2020) 1|''Star Wars'' (2020) 1]] ====Battle of Endor==== {{Quote|Worried? Why would I be worried? Mister find-a-nice-planet-build-a-house-oh-sorry-gotta-go-get-shot-at-some-more-love-ya-babe.|Shara Bey, as Dameron assaulted an Imperial outpost on Endor|}} [[File:KesDameronCourageousSergeant-SWDConv.png|thumb|right|250px|Dameron served as part of the Pathfinders on Endor.]] Eventually Dameron became a [[sergeant]], and during the [[Battle of Endor]], he fought as part of a special-forces group known as the Pathfinders under the command of [[General]] [[Han Solo]]. The group's objective was to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator|generator]] powering the [[Deflector shield|shield]] for the [[orbit]]ing [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]], which would allow the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] to destroy the [[battle station]]. The plan was successful; the Death Star was destroyed, the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], [[Darth Sidious]], was killed, and the Empire was dealt a crippling blow before retreating from [[Endor]]. Dameron and the surviving Pathfinders returned to [[Bright Tree Village]], the home of the native [[Ewok]]s who helped them win the battle, where they and others in the Rebellion celebrated their victory over the Empire. Many of the Alliance pilots and other personnel also ferried down to the village, including Bey, who flew with [[Color|Green]] [[Squadron]] during the battle to destroy the Death Star. They were relieved to find one another safe and sound, and they took a walk through the village to talk about their future and what they would do with the war coming to an end. They then spent the night together. [[File:SharaAndKesVictoryCelebration-ShatteredEmpire1.png|thumb|left|300px|Dameron and Bey reunite during the Rebel victory celebration on Endor.]] The next morning, Solo reassembled the Pathfinders and informed them that a group of Imperials was still holding out in an [[Imperial outpost (Endor)|outpost]] on the far side of Endor. Solo intended to attack the base, not wanting to leave a group of Imperials on Endor after the Ewoks helped the Alliance in the battle. Dameron and the rest of the Pathfinders would [[Assault on an Imperial outpost|assault]] the outpost, while Bey volunteered to [[pilot]] the [[gunship]] that would transport the soldiers to the base. The gunship soon arrived and assaulted the outpost, and the Pathfinders deployed into the area. As he disembarked from the gunship, Dameron told Bey that he was ready to settle down on another [[planet]] and build a house. Dameron and the Pathfinders fought their way into the base, where they found Imperial intelligence suggesting that the Empire still had plans for [[the galaxy]], before returning to the ship. Dameron and Bey were soon sent on separate assignments, with Dameron continuing to serve alongside General Solo. His duties necessitated a communications blackout, so he was unable to speak with Bey for several weeks. ====Final missions==== {{Quote|Let's go ''home'', Shara Bey.|Dameron to Bey, after they both left Rebel service|}} [[File:KesDameronSakasRaid-ShatteredEmpire3.png|thumb|right|300px|Dameron fights alongside Sakas during the raid at the Wretch of Tayron.]] Twenty [[Standard day|days]] after the Battle of Endor, Dameron fought with the Pathfinders in a [[Raid at the Wretch of Tayron|raid]] on the [[Wretch of Tayron|Wretch]] of [[Tayron]], the location of an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] black site in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. He and [[Sakas]], a fellow Pathfinder, performed reconnaissance before the raid began, while other members of the strike team set up charges to infiltrate the secret base. Dameron and other Pathfinders fired several shots at the base, taking out [[All Terrain Scout Transport]]s and other heavy equipment. The Pathfinders moved in, with Dameron having cleared a hole, and began fighting the [[stormtrooper]]s stationed outside the base. Dameron was nearly shot by a [[scout trooper]], but he was saved by Chewbacca, General Solo's [[Wookiee]] companion, who attacked the trooper before he could kill Dameron. Solo soon arrived and reviewed the plan of attack, at which point they entered the base.[[Shattered Empire 3|''Shattered Empire'' 3]] The Pathfinders fought their way through the base and captured its commander before he could purge the data from the ISB computer banks. The commander surrendered, and the Rebels, using the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], [[Slicer|hacked]] into the computers. Once inside the computers, Threepio discovered that an Imperial operation known as [[Operation: Cinder]] was underway, including on [[Naboo]]—where Bey was located, as she was serving as the personal pilot of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. With Naboo under heavy, world-ending siege to enact the Emperor's final wrath, a Rebel fleet under the command of General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] made their way to Naboo. They were able to rescue Bey and Organa, who, along with [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Sosha Soruna]], flew a mission to destroy the Imperial [[satellite]]s being used in an attempt to destroy Naboo. The Rebels stopped the Empire from destroying Naboo, and Dameron reunited with Bey on the Rebel fleet. For his actions during the raid at the Wretch of Tayron, as well as the assault on the Imperial base on Endor, General Solo remarked in a letter to General Madine that Dameron had performed several acts of valor. He also emphasized that Dameron deserved anything he wanted, whether it was R&R or retirement. Solo went so far as to suggest using part of his own compensation package for Dameron.''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]'' [[File:SharaAndKesYavin4-ShatteredEmpire4.png|thumb|left|300px|Dameron and Bey approach their new home on Yavin 4.]] Three [[Standard month|months]] later, Dameron put in a request to end his service to the Rebel Alliance. After the paperwork was approved, Madine wrote back to General Solo, informing him that Dameron had been honorably discharged and given a separate compensation package that would leave Solo's own package untouched. Bey also faced a decision of whether she wanted to leave the Rebellion. Bey eventually chose to follow in her husband's footsteps. After a final [[Mission to Vetine|mission]] with Skywalker, in which Bey helped save and was given ownership of a fragment of a [[Great Tree (Coruscant)|Force-sensitive tree]] that once dwelled in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], she too ended her service to the Rebel Alliance. Dameron and Bey [[Dameron homestead|settled on]] [[Yavin 4]], where they planted the tree from the Jedi Temple. ===Post-war life=== Following the war, Dameron and his family continued their life on Yavin 4. Dameron enjoyed telling his son war stories in contrast to his wife. However, when Poe was just eight, Bey unexpectedly died. Dameron was grief-stricken and became overprotective of his son, who wanted to become a pilot just like his mother. Dameron leaned heavily on his wife's friend [[L'ulo L'ampar]] for support, and the [[Duros]] played a key role in his son's upbringing. As Poe grew up, Dameron's attitude clashed with his son, who wanted to be more free and experience the galaxy in contrast to Dameron's intent to protect his son. In Poe's teenage years, he began to get in trouble for various things, including flying starships without permission. Dameron used his status to bail his son out, but despite this, the rift between them grew. When Poe joined the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]], Kes pursued him with aid from L'ulo. At some point prior to or during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]], while awaiting for an opportunity to attack [[Starkiller Base]], Poe Dameron requested for [[BB-8]] to transmit the updated flight log of [[Black One]] to Yavin 4, believing that his father should be aware of Poe's circumstances in case something went wrong during the mission. ==Personality and traits== Kes Dameron was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with black [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. He loved his wife, Shara Bey, and wanted to start a new life with her after the Empire's defeat in the Battle of Endor, including building a home on another world. Such dreams of the future were ideas he never let himself have before the Battle of Endor, due to the struggles of the Galactic Civil War. Three months after the Battle of Endor, however, they both retired from Rebel service and began a new life together. ==Behind the scenes== Kes Dameron was created for the [[2015]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Shattered Empire 1|''Shattered Empire'' 1]] by [[Greg Rucka]], with art by [[Marco Checchetto]]. The issue identified him as the Rebel soldier who was seen briefly in one of the scenes in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] throwing a shaped charge to Han Solo.{{StarWarsShow|zzDqBKqFvWE|Star Wars: Shattered Empire | The Star Wars Show Book Club|sw_url=video/star-wars-shattered-empire-the-star-wars-show-book-club}} ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox| *{{StoryCite|story=An Echo of Victory|book=Empire Ascendant 1}} *[[Star Wars (2020) 1|''Star Wars'' (2020) 1]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 2|''Star Wars'' (2020) 2]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 6|''Star Wars'' (2020) 6]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 9|''Star Wars'' (2020) 9]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 10|''Star Wars'' (2020) 10]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 11|''Star Wars'' (2020) 11]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 12|''Star Wars'' (2020) 12]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 15|''Star Wars'' (2020) 15]] {{Mo}} *[[Star Wars (2020) 19|''Star Wars'' (2020) 19]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 21|''Star Wars'' (2020) 21]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 22|''Star Wars'' (2020) 22]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 23|''Star Wars'' (2020) 23]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 24|''Star Wars'' (2020) 24]] *[[Dark Droids 1|''Dark Droids'' 1]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 44|''Star Wars'' (2020) 44]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 45|''Star Wars'' (2020) 45]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 46|''Star Wars'' (2020) 46]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 47|''Star Wars'' (2020) 47]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 49|''Star Wars'' (2020) 49]] {{Flash}} *[[Return of the Jedi – The Rebellion 1|''Return of the Jedi – The Rebellion'' 1]] *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} {{Ret}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' {{Ab|Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!
